name: Ticket to Trouble
source:
Murder and romance on rails?! Help the great detective Cora Wolfe solve a mystery aboard an inter-dimensional train in our second mini-adventure!This free to play point-and-click game lets you discover—and possibly romance—more of the Creature Feature Toys characters!

[From [url=https://creaturefeaturetoys.itch.io/tickettotrouble]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
铁轨上的谋杀与浪漫？！在我们的第二次迷你冒险中，帮助伟大的侦探科拉·沃尔夫 (Cora Wolfe) 解开跨维度火车上的谜团！这款免费的点击游戏可让你发现（甚至可能产生浪漫）更多的Creature Feature Toys角色！

[来自[url=https://creaturefeaturetoys.itch.io/tickettotrouble]Itch.io[/url]]
